MetroQuest working prototype for Pune commuters. Visual palette inspired by the user-supplied images.png reference; no OpenAI affiliation, sponsorship or AI functionality is claimed. Product source: https://github.com/Roojool/pune-metro-strava .
Problem framing is a hypothesis to validate with Pune commuters, not a result from completed interviews or market research. No market-size or ridership statistics are claimed.

Implemented demo behavior: manual ride logging, endpoint-only station stamps, shared XP calculations and local community posts/reactions. First new-endpoint ride gives 10 ride XP + 20 for each endpoint = 50. Sources: src/domain/metro.ts, src/state/AppState.tsx in https://github.com/Roojool/pune-metro-strava .

Implementation proof supplied by the engineering lead at pitch creation: 24 tests passing; working hosted web; Android Expo Go demo previously verified; iOS bundle export is not iOS runtime testing. No APK is delivered. Live demo: https://roojool.github.io/pune-metro-strava/ . Prototype uses manual self-reported rides and local state. League identities and community sample profiles are simulations.

Pilot audiences, measurement focus and monetization are proposals, not existing traction, customers or revenue. No actual pilot partners are claimed. This slide is a launch hypothesis for a Pune campus/office pilot.
Call to action: try the live working demo and discuss a Pune campus or office pilot. URL: https://roojool.github.io/pune-metro-strava/ . No investment, partner or usage claims are implied.
